{{Quote|Lord Kasra's illness was fully healed by the Mystic who came to Korriban.''"<br />"''You mean dragged there. At gunpoint. You think they won't remember?|Two Imperials|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kasra''' was a [[Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who fell ill during the [[Galactic War]]. A [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] was kidnapped and brought to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] was forced to heal Kasra.
